_meta.source: Public physics and handbook constants for the cable bus short-circuit and temperature-rise simulation (cablebus_sim). No value is taken from IEEE C37.23 or CSA C22.2 No. 273, whose texts are licensed and were not read.
_meta.note: Every entry carries its own status and citation. Test durations, rise limits and pass criteria of C37.23 / CSA 273 are NOT FOUND publicly, so they are user inputs taken from the product's test report and have no defaults here. The peak-factor entries are informational reference rows only; the simulation computes the peak from X/R in the time domain.

ansi_peak_over_rms_sym.citation: ANSI convention quoted in a secondary source; check 170 kA / 63 kA = 2.70 in the bus duct example

iec_peak_over_rms_sym_60hz.citation: IEC convention 2.5 at 50 Hz / 2.6 at 60 Hz quoted in a secondary source

asym_rms_over_rms_sym.unit: asymmetric rms kA / rms sym kA
asym_rms_over_rms_sym.citation: Switchgear (ANSI) context asymmetrical rms factor, Schneider Electric FAQ FA301513

_meta.note: Cu and Al: 3.45 and 2.5 MJ/(m3 K) as listed in a cable-engineering knowledge base (IEC 60364-5-54 k-factor inputs). XLPE, EPR, PE 2.4 and PVC 1.7 MJ/(m3 K) are the values commonly tabulated with IEC 60287-2-1 / IEC 60853 as remembered; no public page confirming them was found. Replace from the cable maker's data if available.

Simplified laminar free-convection equations for air at atmospheric pressure, h = C (dT / L)^0.25 in W/(m2 K), dT in K and L in m: vertical plate C = 1.42, horizontal plate facing up 1.32 (engineersedge.com summary of Holman, Heat Transfer), horizontal plate facing down 0.59 (Holman, not confirmed on the page). Radiation: grey surface to ambient, h_r = eps sigma (Ts^4 - Ta^4) / (Ts - Ta).

enclosure_convection.default_emissivity_note: FLAGGED DEFAULT: weathered / oxidised aluminium is roughly 0.2 to 0.3, bright sheet about 0.1, painted or anodised 0.8 to 0.9 (Incropera, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, emissivity table; not read). Set the actual enclosure finish.
